findings.title: Comparison table exceeds the plan's three-concept cap
findings.why_it_matters: Plan R1 and U2 require one baseline plus two materially distinct concepts. The main comparison table presents four concept rows, including the superseded two-fan shared variant, and therefore leaves the deliverable over the cap and the ranked scope ambiguous.
findings.suggested_fix: Move the superseded two-fan shared variant into a clearly separate historical/superseded note or appendix, then make the main comparison table and its prose refer only to baseline, compact dedicated, and revised shared airflow.

findings.title: Compact option is called a measured experiment without measurement evidence
findings.why_it_matters: The surrounding documents identify this as a screening calculation and leave hardware qualification and physical measurements not run. Calling it measured blurs the plan's R7 distinction between calculated suitability and hardware evidence.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace measured lower-bound experiment with future lower-bound experiment or screening experiment, or attach the actual measurement receipt if one exists.

residual_risks: Enclosure fit and service clearances remain indeterminate without enclosure CAD.
Hardware temperature, airflow and fault qualification remain not run.
Independent procurement and live availability validation were outside this review scope; dated snapshots are retained as evidence and explicitly require recheck.
testing_gaps: No automated checker currently enforces the three-row comparison cap or scans prose for measured-versus-screening terminology.
